integrity: The proof uses convex projection optimality to classify active sets and classical radical-hyperplane geometry for the simultaneous-active seam. The primary source's exact two-ball projection requirement was inspected in its projection-model paragraph and Remark 4; the prior sphere-intersection projection formula was inspected in full text. A standalone standard-library replay compares the formula against Dykstra on deterministic and random cases.
scientific_limitations: The formula is for the exact Euclidean projector onto the intersection of exactly two finite-dimensional Euclidean balls with nonempty interior. It does not analyze floating-point projection error, does not extend automatically to three or more balls, and does not alter stochastic-gradient oracle complexity.
title: Closed-form Euclidean projection onto the two-ball lens in certified stochastic acceleration
